senses.gloss: m. (ἀρχεῖον, archivum) prefecture, public building, archive. Tanḥ. Ki Thetsé 9 he went לא׳ של וכ׳ into the Egyptian archive; Pesik. Zakh. p. 27ᵃ לבית א׳ Ar. (ed. ארמון, corr. acc.); Yalk. a. l. ארכוון (some ed. ארמון, corr. acc.).
units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:15">Esth. R. to I, 3</cite> <he>להדא א׳ דגדר</he> as in the state-house of Gadara. [<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5">Ex. R. s. 5</cite> <he>בית ארמון</he> corr. acc.]
